description: Search the public BDA temple directory: by name (the canonical ranked name search, top 50, words of at least 3 characters), by exact city, state or country name, and by deity text, or find the nearest temples to a lat/lng within a radius. A request needs a name query, a city, or lat/lng; state, country and deity narrow one of those. Nearest results are exact and nearest-first; where more than 500 temples lie in the area the search narrows its radius, reports searched_radius_km, and sets truncated:true with a note when temples farther out were not ranked. Returns public directory facts, the canonical /teerth URL and a rights label.

city.description: Exact city name, for example Varanasi.

country.description: Exact country name; combine with a query, city or lat/lng.

deity.description: Primary deity text (at least 3 characters), for example Shiva; combine with a query, city or lat/lng.

query.description: Temple name words (English or Hindi), each of at least 3 characters.

state.description: Exact state name, for example Kerala; combine with a query, city or lat/lng.

name: search_temples
